why: Issue #692. The handler decodes the URL itself before the resolver sees it, which puts `decodeURIComponent` back outside any try: the first of the two defects serve-path.mjs was extracted for. `GET /%` then throws URIError out of an async request handler nothing awaits, and in verify.mjs (the required `visual` job) or either uikit script that is an unhandled rejection ending the run. Killed by the malformed-percent-encoding case, whose handler promise now rejects.
killedBy: static-server.mjs: staticHandler answers 404 instead of rejecting on malformed percent-encoding
